heroBubble: Hi, friend! I'm Gritty. I don't always get things right the first time. But that's okay! I keep trying, learn from my mistakes, and never give up.
heroHeading: Any little goat can grow up with grit!
heroText: Welcome to Gritty's world — stories, characters, and activities that help kids ages 4–10 build grit, kindness, and confidence, from teacher, author, and illustrator Kim Rekowski.
reminder: Remember: little by little, you grow BIG!
